sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office Rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你带来了《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们两人才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm excited for the show today.
sentences.zh: 噢，我很期待今天的节目。

sentences.en: I am so tickled about today's episode.
sentences.zh: 我对今天这一集感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: I just loved it so much.
sentences.zh: 我真的太喜欢这一集了。

sentences.en: We have a special interview today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们有一个特别采访。

sentences.en: It is with our safety meeting queen, first AD of The Office, Kelly Cantley.
sentences.zh: 采访对象是我们的安全会议女王，也是《办公室》的第一副导演，凯莉·坎特利。

sentences.en: We love getting mail from all of you, asking questions about Phil Shea and his props tray, or about standards and practices, or Bob Dunn's animal rentals.
sentences.zh: 我们很喜欢收到你们的来信，询问关于菲尔·谢伊和他的道具托盘，或者关于制作标准与规范，又或是鲍勃·邓恩的动物租赁服务的问题。

sentences.en: And you know so many of our crew's names.
sentences.zh: 你们甚至记住了我们这么多剧组成员的名字。

sentences.en: You know the ins and outs of the show now.
sentences.zh: 你们现在对这部剧的方方面面都了如指掌了。

sentences.en: Yes, you have really gotten as invested in the nuts and bolts of the show as we have.
sentences.zh: 没错，你们真的像我们一样，深入了解了这部剧的制作细节。

sentences.en: And so, we're so excited for you to hear about the making of The Office from Kelly's perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们非常期待你们能从凯莉的角度了解《办公室》的制作过程。

sentences.en: This interview, oh my gosh, the nuggets.
sentences.zh: 这次采访，天哪，全是干货。

sentences.en: You know, Kelly was the assistant director for 72 episodes.
sentences.zh: 要知道，凯莉担任了72集的副导演。

sentences.en: She even has more that we want her to come back and tell.
sentences.zh: 她还有更多故事，我们想让她回来继续讲。

sentences.en: Well, when we were getting ready to talk to Kelly, I went in my digital clutter just to see what I could find.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我们准备和凯莉谈话时，我翻了翻我的数字杂物，看看能找到什么。

sentences.en: I found a very funny email.

sentences.en: I want to share with you first, though, that Kelly Cantley and I are very close in height.
sentences.zh: 不过，我想先告诉你们，凯莉·坎特利和我的身高非常接近。

sentences.en: And from time to time, if we were on set, and they were trying to figure something out with my character and I wasn't there,
sentences.zh: 有时在片场，如果他们想为我的角色确定某些事，而我不在场时，

And this is what I found in my digital clutter.
